text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pencegahan dan
Pengawalan Penyakit Berjangkit (Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 1997
dan hendaklah mula berkuatkuasa pada tarikh ia disiarkan dalam
Warta.

2. Bahagian I Jadual Pertama kepada Akta adalah dipinda—

(a) dengan memasukkan selepas butiran 12 butiran dan penyakit
yang berikut:

"12a. Myocarditis."; dan
(b) dengan memasukkan selepas butiran 23 butiran dan penyakit
yang berikut:
"24. Apa-apa jangkitan mikrobial lain yang mengancam
nyawa.".

Dibuat 14 Jun 1997.
(JPN (ADV) 50; PN. (PU2) 470.)
Dato' Chua Jur MENG,
Menteri Kesihatan

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES
(AMENDMENT OF FIRST SCHEDULE) ORDER 1997

Act 342.         IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 30 of the Prevention
and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988, the Minister makes the
following order:

Citation and    1. This order may be cited as the Prevention and Control of

Commencement: Infectious Diseases (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 1997
and shall come into force on the date of its publication in the
Gazette.

Amendment of 2, Part I of the First Schedule to the Act is amended—
First Schedule,

(a) by inserting after item 10 the following item and disease:

"10a. Myocarditis."; and

(6) by inserting after item 23 the following item and disease:

"24. Any other life threatening microbial infection.".

Made 14 June 1997.
(JPN (Adv) 50; PN. (PU?) 470.)
Dato' Chua Jur MENG,
Minister of Health
